newsitem.title: USA: Tecumseh to buy Whirlpool India facility.
newsitem.headline: Tecumseh to buy Whirlpool India facility.

text.p: Tecumseh Products Co said Wednesday it had signed a memorandum to buy Whirlpool of India Ltd's refrigeration compressor manufacturing facilities in Haryana, India.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
Appliance maker Whirlpool Corp of Benton Harbor, Mich., is majority owner of Whirlpool of India Ltd.
Tecumseh said it would continue to make the currently produced refrigeration compressor and would expand capacity to include its CFC-free TP refrigeration compressor.
Annual production capacity once the expansion is completed is expected to be two million compressors, said Tecumseh.

"This acquisition and planned expansion will significantly increase our manufacuturing presence in Asia and will be an important component of our global growth strategy," Tecumseh President and Chief Executive Officer Todd Herrick said in a statement.
The deal is subject to a definitive agreement and various approvals, Tecumseh said.
Tecumseh makes hermetic compressors for air conditioning and refrigeration products, as well as gasoline engines and power train products for lawn and garden applications, and pumps.
